source: class BoxBase {}
class Box<T> : BoxBase {}
class Base(BoxBase item) { public int Marker = 7; }
class Forward<T>(Box<T> item) : Base(item) {}
class Child(Box<int> item) : Forward<int>(item) {}
class Caller<T> {
public int Forwarded() { return new Child(new Box<int>()).Marker; }
class ValueBox<T>(T value) { public T Value = value; }
class ImplicitBox<T> { public T Value; }
class Pair<A, B>(A first, B second) { public A First = first; public B Second = second; }
class GenericCaller<U> {
public T Make<T>(T value) => new ValueBox<T>(value).Value;
public Pair<U, T> MakePair<T>(U first, T second) => new(first, second);
class NullableCaller<U> {
public U? Value(U? value) => Probe.MakeNullable<U>(value);
public U? Declared() => Probe.MakeNullable<U>(null);
public U? Implicit() => Probe.MakeNullableImplicit<U>(null);
class NullableDerived : NullableCaller<bool> {}
class RepeatedPairDerived : NullableCaller<Pair<int, int>> {}
class ChainedCaller<U> { public U Run(U value) => Probe.ForwardConstruction<U>(value); }
class Probe {
public static V ForwardConstruction<V>(V value) => Make<V>(value);
public static int ChainedInt() => new ChainedCaller<int>().Run(7);
public static string ChainedString() => new ChainedCaller<string>().Run("chain");
public static bool RepeatedPairNullable() => new RepeatedPairDerived().Declared() == null && new RepeatedPairDerived().Implicit() == null;
public static bool ForwardedTypes() => new NullableCaller<int>().Value(3) == 3 && new NullableCaller<string>().Value("x") == "x" && new NullableCaller<int>().Value(4) == 4;
public static bool ClassForwardedNullable() => new NullableCaller<float>().Declared() == null;
public static bool ClassForwardedNullableImplicit() => new NullableCaller<int>().Implicit() == null;
public static bool InheritedNullable() => new NullableDerived().Declared() == null && new NullableDerived().Implicit() == null;
public static T? MakeNullable<T>(T? value) => new ValueBox<T?>(value).Value;
public static T? MakeNullableImplicit<T>(T? value) => new ImplicitBox<T?>() { Value = value }.Value;
public static bool NullableDeclared() => MakeNullable<string>(null) == null && MakeNullable<string>("a") == "a";
public static bool NullableImplicit() => MakeNullableImplicit<string>(null) == null && MakeNullableImplicit<string>("b") == "b";
public static int ForwardReceiverless() => new Child(new Box<int>()).Marker;
public static int ForwardUnrelatedReceiver() => new Caller<string>().Forwarded();
static T Make<T>(T value) { ValueBox<T> box = new(value); return box.Value; }
static T MakeImplicit<T>(T value) { ImplicitBox<T> box = new() { Value = value }; return box.Value; }
public static int StaticExplicit() => Make<int>(3);
public static string StaticInferred() => Make("a");
public static bool AlternatingTypes() => Make<int>(3) == 3 && Make<string>("a") == "a" && Make<int>(4) == 4;
public static bool StaticImplicit() => MakeImplicit<int>(8) == 8 && MakeImplicit("implicit") == "implicit" && MakeImplicit<int>(9) == 9;
public static int StaticClassArgument() => Make<ValueBox<int>>(new(5)).Value;
public static int UnrelatedClassReceiver() => new GenericCaller<string>().Make<int>(6);
public static int MixedClassAndFunction() => new GenericCaller<string>().MakePair<int>("a", 7).Second;
